title: Tension in OP
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the tension in segment OP as 3 N from the equilibrium of forces on the movable pulley supporting block A.

title: Mass of Block B
description: Essential: Correctly determines the mass of block B as 0.5 kg from the vertical equilibrium of forces at knot N.

title: Friction Magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the magnitude of the frictional force on block C as 1 N from the horizontal equilibrium of forces at knot N or on block C.

title: Friction Direction
description: Important: Correctly identifies the direction of the frictional force on block C as horizontally to the left (or towards the center).

title: Force Resolution at Knot
description: Important: Correctly resolves the tension forces at knot N using the given angles (37°, 90°) to relate the tension to the weight of block B.

title: Movable Pulley Equilibrium
description: Important: Correctly applies the equilibrium condition for the movable pulley, recognizing the symmetry of tensions and relating them to the weight of block A.

title: Sign or Direction Error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the direction of friction (e.g., to the right) or misinterprets the force balance on block C.

title: Angle Misapplication
description: Pitfall: Uses incorrect trigonometric functions (sine vs. cosine) when resolving forces at knot N or for the movable pulley geometry.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (N, kg, m/s²) throughout the calculation and presents final answers with correct units.
